responsibility: Contains the executable MSP430 backend implementation behind the target hooks declared by msp430.h and used by msp430.md. It manages target option override and MCU-derived configuration, machine_function/frame-layout state, calling-convention and return-address helpers, include-path registration for MSP430 support headers, assembly operand/address printing, mode and register-class restrictions for MSP430’s 16-bit and 20-bit PSImode model, and numerous code-generation utilities such as prologue/epilogue support and instruction-emission helpers including extension and shift sequences. This is the core C/C++ logic of the MSP430 code generator, consuming GCC RTL/tree target state and producing target-specific expansion, diagnostics, and final assembly formatting behavior.
same_name_distinction: This is the executable C backend for MSP430 target hooks and code-generation helpers, including option override, frame handling, operand printing, and include-path registration that uses msp430-devices data. Unlike msp430.h it does not define the target-description macros/specs, unlike msp430.md it is not the RTL machine-description patterns, and unlike msp430.opt it is not the option-definition file.
